readerCopy.summary: The person with the title faces the person who controls the money, records, or access required to make the title matter.
readerCopy.body: The person with the title faces the person who controls the money, records, or access required to make the title matter. One side claims public authority; the other can delay, narrow, or quietly disable every decision made without its consent. The Sun holds the title, while Pluto points directly to the money, records, and access making that title useful. The opposition forces formal leadership to face the private control making its decisions optional. The outcome may settle who signs the order, but it also shows who can make that signature useless.
